correctness.rationale: PASS: explicitly reconstructed units as invertible vertex-diagonal labels plus square-zero arrow coordinates. At a fixed diagonal vector, unipotent conjugation removes precisely arrows with unequal endpoint labels and contributes q^{m-|E0|} to a class size. Remaining exact nonzero support S is acted on by torus vertex rescalings; stabilizer order (q-1)^{c(S)}, orbit size (q-1)^{r(S)}, number of support orbits (q-1)^{beta(S)}. Summing over diagonal labels gives the nonnegative form, then expanding equality indicators yields the claimed two-subset polynomial. Specialization at X=Y=1 exactly gives Tutte(q,q), with rooted-forest and cycle transfer derivations. Independent direct finite unit-group conjugacy compared to a separate support formula on 7 cases including q=2,q=3, parallel and loop edges; each passed. q=2 Y-markers must be numerically collapsed; correctly stated.
